observations: Blue game console wrapped in protective plastic film.
Gold PlayStation face button symbols (Triangle, Circle, Cross, Square) on the top surface.
PlayStation logo in the corner of the top surface.
The console has the thin, two-tier design characteristic of the PS4 Slim.
Watermark 'THE GAME GUY VENTURES' appears on all photos.

identity.model: PlayStation 4 Slim Days of Play Limited Edition

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the blue Days of Play limited edition console.

claims.claim: 10 latest games. Such as FIFA and PES 2027
claims.evidence: No photos show the screen or game discs. Note: PES 2027 does not exist.
The exterior appears clean and is wrapped in plastic.
Requires a clear shot of the warranty seal on the rear of the console.
Requires a video of the console running a demanding game for at least 20 minutes.
Requires testing of HDMI, USB, and power ports.
The controller shown in photo 1 is camouflage; the Days of Play edition originally came with a matching blue controller. Only one pad is shown despite the plural 'pads'.
The receipt is not shown in any photo.

risks.risk: The console may have been opened or repaired despite claims.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the factory warranty seal over the screw holes on the back.

risks.risk: The '10 latest games' may be digital accounts that can be locked or non-existent.
risks.proof: A video of the console's library screen showing the games and their launchability.

risks.risk: The camouflage controller may be a third-party replica rather than an original Sony pad.
risks.proof: A close-up of the rear sticker of the controller showing the model and FCC ID.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the console showing the warranty seal.
Photo of the console turned on showing the 'Storage' and 'Library' screens.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned in the description.
Photo of the second 'original pad' mentioned.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a PS4 Slim Limited Edition. While the games and second controller are unproven, the console itself can be priced at its worst-case value as a standalone unit with one controller.
